visualReview: All 46 video files compared with the pre-compression runtime revision at 10%, 50% and 90%; see videos-01.jpg through videos-08.jpg. Five representative image comparisons in image-comparison.jpg. This is representative visual inspection, not every-frame visual review.
validation: Every runtime video fully decoded with ffmpeg; frame counts, dimensions, average frame rates and packet presentation timestamps compared; compressed audio payload hashes matched. All images decoded and dimensions checked; transparency retained. Protected brand artwork and TetoIcon assets checked for identical decoded RGBA pixels. No app compile, typecheck, simulator, app launch, or tests.
